changelog: New spoken-punctuation foot/inch signs: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'inch sign' (or 'ইঞ্চি চিহ্ন') while dictating and ″ attaches to the previous word ('fifty five inch sign TV' → 'fifty five″ TV'), 'foot sign' → ′ ('five foot sign six inch sign' → 'five′ six″') — for dictating product sizes and heights instead of typing ′ ″ by hand. A bare 'foot'/'inch' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
